newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rugby Union - Smith called up by New South Wales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rugby Union - Smith called up by New South Wales.

text.p: Randwick winger Gareth Smith has been called into New South Wales' squad for two Super 12 matches in South Africa later this month as cover for David Campese, who is playing in the Hong Kong Sevens.
The Waratahs will face Transvaal at Ellis Park in Johannesburg on March 22 before travelling to Durban for the fixture against Natal one week later.
New South Wales lost their opening Super 12 match against Waikato at home last Saturday and take on another New Zealand team, Canterbury, at Sydney Football Stadium tonight.

Campese will be unavailable for the match against Transvaal because of his commitment to represent Australia in Hong Kong, prompting Smith's selection in a 26-man squad. Smith can also cover at fullback and as a goal kicker.

New South Wales squad: Mark Bell, Andrew Blades, Cameron Blades, Graeme Bond, Scott Bowen, Tom Bowman, Michael Brial, Matthew Burke, David Campese, Sam Domoni, Fili Finau, Tim Gavin, Richard Harry, Andrew Heath, Phil Kearns, Chris Latham, Adam Leach, Jason Madz, Daniel Manu, Alistair Murdoch, Sam Payne, Stu Pinkerton, Gareth Smith, Nathan Spooner, Richard Tombs, Chris Whitaker.
